newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state offers 40 pct of sixth miller Sept 22.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state offers 40 pct of sixth miller Sept 22.

text.p: Egypt's official East Delta Flour Mills said on Friday it was offering investors at least 2.4 million shares on September 22.
The miller's chairman had said earlier the state was planning to sell 10 percent or 600,000 shares of the firm for 25.00 pounds a share.

The state regards milling firms as strategic, saying it would not sell more than 40 percent of its holding but heavy demand for an earlier privatisation, Central and West Delta Flour Mills, may push it to change its mind.
East Delta Flour Mills manufactures bread and pasta for distribution in the eastern provinces of Port Said and Damietta.
The firm increased net profits for the 1995/96 financial year which ended on June 30 to 27.78 million pounds from 27.66 million a year earlier.
